scripts.build: npm run lint:structure:source && npm run check:frontend:source && npm run format:source:check && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/mini-app run lint && node apps/mini-app/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config apps/mini-app/eslint.e2e.config.mjs tests/e2e tests/extension-e2e --max-warnings=0 && npm run lint:source
scripts.check:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test-storybook && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check:frontend:source: npm run lint && npm run lint:fsd && npm run lint:structure && npm run lint:react && npm run format:check && npm run knip
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix apps/mini-app run lint:fix && node apps/mini-app/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config apps/mini-app/eslint.e2e.config.mjs tests/e2e tests/extension-e2e --fix --max-warnings=0 && npm run lint:source:fix
scripts.format:source:check: prettier --check apps/daemon/src apps/chrome-extension/src apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/forge.config.cjs apps/desktop/package.json apps/daemon/bin apps/server/src packages scripts tests eslint "*.{ts,mjs,js}" apps/daemon/eslint.config.mjs
scripts.security:check: node scripts/security/check.mjs worktree && node scripts/security/check.mjs history
scripts.validate:commit: npm run security:test && npm run format:repository:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:extension && npm run build:desktop && node scripts/validation/native-helper.mjs && npm test -- --maxWorkers=4
scripts.validate: npm run security:check && npm run validate:commit
scripts.format:repository:check: prettier --check README.md SECURITY.md package.json .github docs/screenshots docs/chrome-extension.md docs/accounts-and-keys.md docs/desktop.md
scripts.check:extension:source: node scripts/extension/check-source.mjs && node apps/mini-app/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config eslint.config.mjs apps/chrome-extension/src scripts/extension --max-warnings=0 && prettier --check apps/chrome-extension/src scripts/extension
scripts.test:extension: vitest run tests/extension tests/native tests/local tests/application-client-contract.test.ts tests/host-runtime-lifecycle.test.ts tests/browser-cli.test.ts
scripts.test:extension:e2e: npm run build:extension && playwright test --config playwright.extension.config.ts
